verdict.rationale: Postman documents a Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and integrating with toolchains, plus an Analytics API. It is complemented by an official CLI (collections, mocks, governance, webhooks, SDK generation), an official MCP server, and a published OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence claims UI-API parity, and many UI capabilities (live sessions, comments, role and permission management, Spec Hub, visual workflows) are never shown to be reachable through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-API parity statement, documented API coverage of collaboration and permission features, and independent or hands-on confirmation of breadth.
